صُبَاحِىٌّ Intensely red blood: (K, TA:) from أَصْبَحُ signifying one “ whose hair is overspread with redness. ” (TA.) ＝
-A2- أَسِنَّةٌ صُبَاحِيَّةٌ Wide spear-heads. (K, TA. [In the CK the latter word is without teshdeed.]) ISd says, I know not the person or thing in relation whereto they are thus called. (TA.) [See also مِصْبَاحٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
